launcher.result: FAIL: original guest gives a mutex owned by loopTask while executing InputHandler.

source.finding: Panel_Device::getTouchRaw ends a shared transaction before invoking the touch driver and thus before testing its IRQ. The original owner violation occurs with the touch IRQ high.

launcher.limit: The exact original build ELF and complete library manifest are unavailable. Compatible source is not presented as an exact original build. No assertion or scheduling semantics were bypassed; no physical hardware comparison has run.

rfid.result: PARTIAL: missing PN532Killer UART peer prevents startup completion; original task-watchdog panic reproduced independently.
rfid.loop_task_wait: UART RX ring buffer wait, called by PN532Killer initialization
rfid.protocol_scope: PN532 framing with a vendor command 0xaa, wakeup bytes and SAMConfiguration 0x14/0x01. No receiver is attached; command 0xaa semantics and card behavior are not implemented or claimed.
rfid.source_limit: Exact commit 3b15159 was not found in either the declared author fork or upstream GitHub commit API. No unrelated source/ELF substituted.

meshtastic.result: PARTIAL at this runtime: saved loopTask stack is in the main-loop 50-tick timed wait after NimBLE sync/GATT; not an infinite startup controller poll.
meshtastic.observation_limit: The previously retained normal 140-second run has a late black frame. A later startup panel trace shows a Welcome UI but with rotation and DMA clipping; a late black frame alone is insufficient to infer that the app never booted. No claim is made that tracing is a normal-lane readiness test.
